title: chenopodium ambrosioides var. chilense
intro: Chenopodium ambrosioides var. chilense, commonly known as Mexican tea or Epazote, is a plant species belonging to the family Amaranthaceae. It has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, such as bloating and gas, as well as its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mexican tea include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve nausea, and act as a natural carminative and antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polyphenols, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
